rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re excited to propose a collaborative Instagram post designed to celebrate the core values of your Direct Trade model. As our team, we believe that sharing these insights with your audience will deepen their appreciation for the commitment to quality and producer relationships.  [P6] “As our business continues to evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.”  [P9] “We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.”  [P5] “Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.”  [F4] “The post will highlight the importance of these relationships and the positive impact they have on the producers.”  We envision a visually compelling post that captures the essence of your brand – a moment of connection and appreciation.  We believe this collaboration will strengthen your relationship with our audience and further solidify your position as a leader in the specialty coffee industry.  The post will encourage viewers to engage with the Stumptown Coffee Roasters Instagram feed.

The BrandPilot team
